one_idea.line: Yes. The auditor opening old pages and finding money or a skeleton carries both cuts. With carry (state.ts: each count_to starts from the value on screen, no ghost drawn), k_after, l_after and l_k count down from $195,000 to $33,000 on 'fell' and '33', as the idea's move says. The hook line goes through $195,000, the slam words land on his words, the real pages are held still, and the sofa and closet plates come on 'missing money' and 'skeletons'.

no_invented_numbers.line: No invented figure. All four counters show only the bill-billed and bill-after rows (195,000 and 33,000) as money in USD with their source line. Under carry the in-between values are motion between the two owned figures, and no ghost figure is drawn. No slam word or tape has a digit, and the figures on th_head, l_lede and l_krafton are printed on their own pages.
